purpose: Supplement recovery-ledger-2026-08-29.json and recovery-ledger-addendum-2026-08-29.json with the first hard data closing the 'actual cash collections' and 'AG $90M breakdown' gaps identified in known_missing_components.

entries.interpretation: This is the restitution-ordered component of the AG's $90M 'judgments and recoveries' headline figure. It is a court order, not cash in hand.

First hard figure in this corpus for actual cash collected against the $90M headline: roughly 9% of the $32M restitution-ordered component. The AG's office says it plays no role in collection; that is the probation system's and courts' function.

AG-stated civil-judgments component of the $90M figure. DHS confirmation of this figure was requested by KSTP and still pending as of publication; treat as provisional. Note: $32M + $61M = $93M, ~$3M more than the AG's own $90M headline; this discrepancy is unexplained and unresolved.
A differently-scoped, non-exhaustive 48-case sample with $2.355M (~17.7%) collected. Do not merge with the KSTP $32M/$3M figures; see contradiction-restitution-collection-scope-kstp-vs-fox9.
